name: Balsamic Chicken Wrap with Goat Cheese, Cranberries, Arugula & Mandarins (Prep-Ahead)

instructions.primary_message: This recipe utilizes 2 medium food storage containers.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the chicken dry with paper towels and cut into bite-sized pieces. Season with salt and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
227 g chicken breasts, boneless skinless
¼ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chicken and cook, stirring occasionally, until cooked through, 4-5 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, remove chicken to a plate. (Reserve skillet with cooking juices for later use.)
Meanwhile, place goat cheese and cranberries into a small bowl. Use the back of a spoon to mash and combine. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ (113 g) log goat cheese
⅛ cup dried cranberries

instructions.primary_message: Using a clean cutting board, peel, halve, and slice onion crosswise into thin half-moons.
Return skillet (with cooking juices) to medium-high heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion, salt, and pepper; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 3-4 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tsp extra virgin olive oil
salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add vinegar and sugar to the skillet. Continue to cook, stirring constantly, until the vinegar is reduced, about 1 minute. Add onions to the plate with the chicken and set aside to cool completely, about 15 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp balsamic vinegar
1 tsp brown sugar

instructions.primary_message: When the chicken and onions are cool, wash and dry arugula (skip this step if it came pre-washed).
Place tortillas on a flat surface, spread with cranberry goat cheese, then top with chicken, onions, and arugula. Roll tightly to close and cut in half.
Place wraps in the storage containers, cover, and refrigerate until ready to eat. Enjoy wraps with mandarins!
